channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-102764 — BeyondTrust Remote Support
item.description: Threat Signal 82. BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

item.title: CVE-2026-97229 — GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition
item.description: Threat Signal 83. GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

item.title: CVE-2026-88771 — Citrix NetScaler
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-96652 — Plex Media Server
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

item.title: CVE-2026-20128 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a storing passwords in a recoverable format vulnerability that allows an authenticated, local attacker to gain DCA user privileges by accessing a credential file for the DCA user on the filesystem as a low-privileged user.

item.title: CVE-2026-96655 — Plex Media Server
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

item.title: CVE-2026-41709 — Broadcom VMware ESX
item.description: Threat Signal 54. Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

item.title: CVE-2026-20133 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains an exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to view sensitive information on affected systems.

item.title: CVE-2026-110936 — Siemens Software Center
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

item.title: CVE-2022-21919 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 55. Microsoft Windows User Profile Service contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2025-55182 — Meta React Server Components
item.description: Threat Signal 92. Meta React Server Components contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution by exploiting a flaw in how React decodes payloads sent to React Server Function endpoints. Please note CVE-2025-66478 has been rejected, but it is associated with CVE-2025- 55182.

item.title: CVE-2026-72898 — Metabase Metabase
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Metabase contains a SQL Injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to inject arbitrary SQL into the Metabase application database, which can give them administrator access to the instance. From there, the attacker could change the application configuration, steal stored credentials for the connected databases, read any data accessible through those connections, and export data.

item.title: CVE-2026-8037 — Progress LoadMaster
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Progress LoadMaster contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an un-authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the LoadMaster appliance by exploiting unsanitized input in multiple command endpoints.

item.title: CVE-2025-61884 — Oracle E-Business Suite
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Oracle E-Business Suite contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in the Runtime component of Oracle Configurator. This vulnerability is remotely exploitable without authentication.

item.title: CVE-2024-57727 — SimpleHelp SimpleHelp
item.description: Threat Signal 84. SimpleHelp remote support software contains multiple path traversal vulnerabilities that allow unauthenticated remote attackers to download arbitrary files from the SimpleHelp host via crafted HTTP requests. These files may include server configuration files and hashed user passwords.

item.title: CVE-2023-28461 — Array Networks AG/vxAG ArrayOS
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Array Networks AG and vxAG ArrayOS contain a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an attacker to read local files and execute code on the SSL VPN gateway.

item.title: CVE-2022-36537 — ZK Framework AuUploader
item.description: Threat Signal 84. ZK Framework AuUploader servlets contain an unspecified vulnerability that could allow an attacker to retrieve the content of a file located in the web context. The ZK Framework is an open-source Java framework. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to ConnectWise R1Soft Server Backup Manager.

item.title: CVE-2023-0669 — Fortra GoAnywhere MFT
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Fortra (formerly, HelpSystems) GoAnywhere MFT contains a pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability in the License Response Servlet due to deserializing an attacker-controlled object.

item.title: CVE-2022-27925 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains flaw in the mboximport functionality, allowing an authenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2022-37042 which allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-27924 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) allows an attacker to inject memcache commands into a targeted instance which causes an overwrite of arbitrary cached entries.

item.title: CVE-2016-0189 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 84. The Microsoft JScript nd VBScript engines, as used in Internet Explorer and other products, allow attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2010-0188 — Adobe Reader and Acrobat
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Unspecified vulnerability in Adobe Reader and Acrobat allows attackers to cause a denial of service or possibly execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2018-15982 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Adobe Flash Player com.adobe.tvsdk.mediacore.metadata Use After Free Vulnerability

item.title: CVE-2018-4878 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Adobe Flash Player contains a use-after-free vulnerability that could allow for code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-26411 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for memory corruption.

item.title: CVE-2019-11539 — Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure and Pulse Policy Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure and Policy Secure allows an authenticated attacker from the admin web interface to inject and execute commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-83548 — SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances
item.description: Threat Signal 66. SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

item.title: CVE-2026-48939 — iCagenda iCagenda
item.description: Threat Signal 66. iCagenda contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows the upload of arbitrary files in the file attachment feature, ultimately resulting in PHP code upload and execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-28318 — SolarWinds Serv-U
item.description: Threat Signal 66. SolarWinds Serv-U contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows specially crafted POST requests using the Content-Encoding: deflate header to crash the Serv-U service without authentication.

item.title: CVE-2026-45247 — Mirasvit Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by supplying a crafted serialized PHP object in the CacheWarmer cookie.

item.title: CVE-2026-48172 — LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin
item.description: Threat Signal 66. LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin contains privilege escalation vulnerability that is exposed via the user-end cPanel plugin, which can be abused by any cPanel user account to execute arbitrary scripts with root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2024-37079 — Broadcom VMware vCenter Server
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Broadcom VMware vCenter Server contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the implementation of the DCERPC protocol. This could allow a malicious actor with network access to vCenter Server to send specially crafted network packets, potentially leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2014-3931 — Looking Glass Multi-Router Looking Glass (MRLG)
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Multi-Router Looking Glass (MRLG) contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause an arbitrary memory write and memory corruption.

item.title: CVE-2023-33538 — TP-Link Multiple Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 66. TP-Link TL-WR940N V2/V4, TL-WR841N V8/V10, and TL-WR740N V1/V2 contain a command injection vulnerability via the component /userRpm/WlanNetworkRpm. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2023-39780 — ASUS RT-AX55 Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 66. ASUS RT-AX55 devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote, authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. As represented by CVE-2023-41346.

item.title: CVE-2025-32756 — Fortinet Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Fortinet FortiFone, FortiVoice, FortiNDR and FortiMail contain a stack-based overflow vulnerability that may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via crafted HTTP requests.

item.title: CVE-2024-11120 — GeoVision Multiple Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Multiple GeoVision devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to inject and execute arbitrary system commands. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2025-25181 — Advantive VeraCore
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Advantive VeraCore contains a SQL injection vulnerability in timeoutWarning.asp that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL commands via the PmSess1 parameter.

item.title: CVE-2025-22225 — VMware ESXi
item.description: Threat Signal 66. VMware ESXi contains an arbitrary write vulnerability. Successful exploitation allows an attacker with privileges within the VMX process to trigger an arbitrary kernel write leading to an escape of the sandbox.

item.title: CVE-2024-9380 — Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA)
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the administrative console which can allow an authenticated attacker with application admin privileges to pass commands to the underlying OS.

item.title: CVE-2023-4762 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2023-5631 — Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Roundcube Webmail contains a persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to run malicious JavaScript code.

item.title: CVE-2023-32434 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Apple iOS. iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain an integer overflow vulnerability that could allow an application to execute code with kernel privileges.

item.title: CVE-2023-3079 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2023-33009 — Zyxel Multiple Firewalls
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Zyxel ATP, USG FLEX, USG FLEX 50(W), USG20(W)-VPN, VPN, and ZyWALL/USG firewalls contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in the notification function that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause denial-of-service (DoS) conditions and remote code execution on an affected device.

item.title: CVE-2023-33010 — Zyxel Multiple Firewalls
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Zyxel ATP, USG FLEX, USG FLEX 50(W), USG20(W)-VPN, VPN, and ZyWALL/USG firewalls contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in the ID processing function that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause denial-of-service (DoS) conditions and remote code execution on an affected device.

item.title: CVE-2023-2033 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2022-41223 — Mitel MiVoice Connect
item.description: Threat Signal 66. The Director component in Mitel MiVoice Connect allows an authenticated attacker with internal network access to execute code within the context of the application.

item.title: CVE-2022-40765 — Mitel MiVoice Connect
item.description: Threat Signal 66. The Mitel Edge Gateway component of MiVoice Connect allows an authenticated attacker with internal network access to execute commands within the context of the system.

item.title: CVE-2022-41073 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM-level privileges.
